method: Manual research checked 16 November 2026. Employer ATS feeds (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Keka and Teamtailor), official career pages, and employer-authored YC postings establish advertised India availability. Distinct requisitions are retained; duplicate application URLs and company/title/location tuples are rejected, and near-identical Ema infrastructure postings are consolidated. Descriptions are short editorial paraphrases. Posting dates use source published/created fields; relative or unavailable dates remain blank with a separate verification date. Unspecified work style, salary and closing dates are not invented. Key skills reflect technologies explicitly mentioned in each JD, including preferred tools. Advertised availability is not a guarantee that a role remains open. A later cross-source pass added employer-authored Wellfound postings and remote OrbitShift roles discovered on LinkedIn/Himalayas and confirmed on its Zoho careers feed. See source-search.json for coverage and excluded leads.
